name: Tavily
shortDescription: Search API for agents that need web results. Free to start. Paid plans are on their site.
longDescription: Tavily is a search API meant for agents. The free plan includes 1,000 API credits per month. Paid plans start at $30 per month.
pricingNotes: Usage samples also showed paid figures, confirm free credit allotment on page.
bestFor: Agent retrieval that starts with web search
Apps that want search results without a full browser
notIdealFor: Crawling your own site into a corpus
strength: The free plan includes 1,000 API credits per month for agent web search.
weakness: The next plan starts at $30 per month, and the API returns search results rather than clicking through a logged-in site.

useCaseFit.tool-use-browser: Search API that gives an agent web results, with 1,000 free credits a month.
useCaseFit.research-rag: Search API for agents that need web results, with a free credit plan.
